title: Generating Hematopoietic Stem Cells from AGM-derived Hemogenic Precursors in a Stroma-free Engineered Niche
protocol: Combine Notch antibodies (anti-Notch1 and anti-Notch2) with recombinant fibronectin fragment or recombinant mouse VCAM-1/CD106 Fc Chimera in Ca+Mg+-free PBS.
Add approximately 0.25 ml of ligand solution per well to a non-tissue culture plastic 48-well plate.
Incubate the plate overnight at 4°C.
Prepare serum-free media for the number and types of wells being plated on the day of culture initiation.
Aspirate the ligand solution from each well and add excess PBS, ensuring the well does not dry out. Repeat once.
Aspirate PBS from each well and add 0.4 ml of serum-free media per 48-well plate.
Set up timed matings of C57BI6/J7 mice for generating embryonic tissues of the desired age.
Harvest embryos from pregnant females at 9.5 to 11.5 days post coitum (dpc).
Dissect the AGM or central portion of the embryo proper containing the para-aortic splanchnopleure/P-Sp from the embryos on ice-cold PBS with 10% FBS.
Collect the pooled P-Sp/AGM tissues in a 15ml conical tube containing 10 ml PBS with 10% FBS on ice.
Add 1 ml of 0.25% collagenase to the collected tissues and place in a 37°C water bath for 25 min.
Pipette about 20-30 times with a 1 ml pipette tip to obtain a single cell suspension after adding 1 ml of PBS/10% FBS.
Centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 min.
Prepare the blocking buffer for antibody staining by adding 10 μg/ml anti-mouse CD16/CD32 and 1 μg/mL DAPI to PBS with 10% FBS in a volume of 1 ml.
Sterilize the blocking buffer using a 0.22-micron syringe filter.
Resuspend the cell pellet from dissociated murine embryonic tissues in 500 μl blocking buffer and incubate on ice for 5 min.

Prepare an antibody mix by adding 10 μg/ml FcR block to PBS with 10% FBS, then add 10 μL each of fluorochrome-conjugated antibodies (VEcadherin-PECy7, EPCR-PerCP-eFluor710, and CD61-APC) to make a final volume of 1 ml.
Sterilize the antibody mix using a 0.22-micron syringe filter.
Add 0.5 ml of the antibody mix to the cell pellet in blocking buffer from above.
Incubate on ice for at least 20 minutes.
Add 9 ml PBS/10% FBS and centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 min.
Aspirate and re-suspend the cell pellet in 0.5 ml PBS/10% FBS.
Pipette the cell suspension through a 35-micron cell strainer cap on a 5 ml tube.
Perform fluorescence-activated cell sorting (FACS) by gating on SSC and FSC.
Set gates using relatively broad gates for FSC-A, FSC-W, and SSC-W to exclude doublets.
Gate on live cells as DAPI negative.
Gate on VE-Cadherin positive cells.
Gate on the subset that is positive for both EPCR and CD61.
Use isotype control and fluor-minus one (FMO) samples to set thresholds for gates.
Set the sorting machine to the lowest flow rate of 1.0 to minimize shear stress.
Sort cells into a 5 ml tube containing cold PBS/10% FBS.
Centrifuge cells at 300 x g for 10 min after sorting.
Aspirate and re-suspend the cell pellet in serum-free media (enough for 100 microliters/48-well).
Re-suspend approximately 1-2 embryo equivalent of sorted cells per 48-well.
Add 100 microliters of cell suspension to each 48-well.
Culture cells for 6-7 days in a 37°C tissue culture incubator with 5% CO2.
Harvest cells by pipetting vigorously and scraping wells with the pipette tip.
Remove 10% of harvested cells for phenotyping.
Use the remaining 90% of harvested cells for transplantation or secondary assays.
